task.title: M1: Ref resolution and detached-worktree lifecycle
task.description:
Resolve user-supplied refs (branch, tag, SHA, HEAD, or the pseudo-ref WORKTREE) to a SHA and a readable root directory without ever touching the user's working tree. HEAD and WORKTREE analyze the current checkout directly; any other ref is materialized with git worktree add --detach in a temporary directory and removed afterwards, including when analysis throws or the process is interrupted. WORKTREE represents uncommitted changes, resolves to no SHA, and must be flagged so callers never cache it.

Acceptance criteria:
- resolveRef(repo, ref) returns { sha, ref, kind: 'head' | 'worktree' | 'detached' } and rejects unknown refs with a clear error.
- withCheckout(repo, ref, fn) runs fn against a root path; for detached refs the temporary worktree is removed and git worktree prune leaves no stale entries, even if fn rejects.
- SIGINT during a detached analysis still cleans up the temporary worktree.
- WORKTREE analysis reads the live checkout and is marked uncacheable in the returned context.
- Tests exercise HEAD, a tag, a non-HEAD SHA, WORKTREE, and the failure-cleanup path against a temporary repo.
